protocol: minigrid_decide_after_delay_v2: Key/Ball identity shown in the first sensor frame, eight later frames contain neither object (optionally with a distractor object injected mid-sequence at distractor_ratio), final decision must match the first-frame identity; inputs are position-invariant presence features; counterfactual swap probe flips the identity->choice mapping at evaluation time, so a controller that genuinely uses remembered identity shows large (heldout - swapped) evidence, while a route/shortcut scores identically under both mappings; no teacher action, path oracle, seed answer, or reward signal of any kind.
